A '''hepatizon spear''' is the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] [[spear]], made by smithing a [[Copper Spear|copper spear]] with [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]]. It deals 3 damage at an attack speed of 1.18 and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_spear.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

Held in the main hand, it adds 0.011 to movement speed (10.5% of the base speed).

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Lunge]] III

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Hepatizon equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_spear.json}}</ref>

{{History line|1.12|The spear's real attack speed now matches its tooltip.}}
